# backend/tests/fixtures — Folder Contract

## Architecture Summary

Explicit test-only subprocess fixtures. These programs model external protocols deterministically and may write only to test-owned temporary paths supplied by the test harness. Production code must never select them.

## File Table

| File | Pos | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `claude_mcp_fake_cli.py` | Claude MCP argv/PTTY fixture | Model version/list/get/login/logout, redirect stdin, timeout, malformed output, cancellation, and non-zero exit without real OAuth. |
| `claude_agent_sandbox_fake_provider.py` | Claude Agent container fixture | Serve deterministic Anthropic SSE tool-call responses for either the default workspace/credential sandbox probe or an explicit test-owned Bash command. |
| `ntn` | Notion CLI executable fixture | Accept one exact read-only API-search argv and return a content-free marker without credentials or network access. |
| `notion_cli_runtime_probe.py` | compiled Runtime probe | Run the production Runner/SDK/Runtime path against local fake provider and ntn fixtures, emitting only decision/result metadata. |
| `claude_registry_release.json` | registry release fixture identity | Supply non-production exact SDK/Runtime/CLI versions and the five-package inventory for local archive/runner tests; contains no registry URL, token, model data, or production artifact. |
| `claude_mcp_inventory_server.py` | stdio/SSE inventory fixture | Expose deterministic read-only tool/resource/prompt inventory through standard FastMCP; optional two-page SDK `nextCursor` mode remains explicit and production never selects it implicitly. |
